Geopolitical.name: Geopolitical Conflict & Supply Disruption Shock
Geopolitical.description: Severe military conflict or regional blockade driving commodity spikes, risk-off equity contagion, and high-yield credit freeze.

Credit Event.name: Systemic Credit Contagion & Default Surge Shock
Credit Event.description: Counterparty defaults and commercial real estate distressed liquidation triggering credit spread blowouts and severe rating downgrades.

Macroeconomic.name: Aggressive Monetary Tightening & Stagflation Shock
Macroeconomic.description: Unexpected central bank emergency rate hike combined with sticky inflation, steepening yield curves and driving heavy duration losses.

Cyber/Systemic Risk.name: Financial Infrastructure & Settlement Disruption Shock
Cyber/Systemic Risk.description: Coordinated cyber outage or interbank clearing failure causing immediate liquidity panic, derivative settlement discounts, and operational losses.

Regulatory/Legal.name: Strict Capital Surcharge & Compliance Clampdown Shock
Regulatory/Legal.description: Regulatory tightening increasing bank RWA capital buffer requirements and placing penal provisions on wholesale asset books.

Merger/Acquisition.name: Antitrust Block & Event Arbitrage Failure Shock
Merger/Acquisition.description: Regulatory blocking of high-profile acquisitions causing idiosyncratic corporate spread widenings and equity target repricing.

Product Launch.name: Capital Investment & Expansion Benchmark
Product Launch.description: Positive technology or infrastructure rollouts driving modest growth and tightening credit risk premia.
